latHint: Think a call in the swimming pool - not a horse sport.
pivHint: POLO is played on horseback - but in the pool game, who shouts what before POLO hears an answer?
winText: Splash! POLO was the pivot - a horse sport to the pool game with MARCO.
lossText: MARCO - the shout in a pool game. POLO was the pivot: horse POLO to MARCO POLO.
